ACTION_SCHEDULER.basis: recurring action API and scheduling semantics

CHROME_ACTION.basis: MV3 action behavior and action.onClicked/popup semantics

CHROME_ACTIVE_TAB.basis: activeTab is a temporary user-gesture grant; action and context-menu invocations are qualifying gestures

CHROME_CONTEXT_MENUS.basis: contextMenus permission, service-worker onClicked listener and tab-bound context-menu invocation

CHROME_MV3_SW.basis: MV3 extension service worker lifecycle/event-driven execution

CHROME_OFFSCREEN.basis: MV3 offscreen document lifecycle, bundled static HTML, runtime messaging, WEB_RTC/DISPLAY_MEDIA reasons, create/close semantics

CHROME_TABCAPTURE.basis: tabCapture requires user invocation; getMediaStreamId is one-use/short-lived; Chrome 116+ service-worker stream IDs can be consumed in an offscreen document; getCapturedTabs/onStatusChanged support capture lifecycle

GSC_INDEXING_API.basis: restricted supported content and bounded batch semantics

GSC_SEARCH_ANALYTICS.basis: top rows not exhaustive, rowLimit/startRow, hourly_all, FAQ searchAppearance deprecation

GSC_URL_INSPECTION.basis: URL Inspection reports indexed-version state, not live test

MARIADB_MULTI_INSERT.basis: multi-value INSERT and set-based SQL execution

MCP_2026_07_28.basis: stateless core, server/discover, header routing, cache hints, extensions, CIMD/DCR deprecation, RFC 9207

OPENAI_CHATGPT_UI.basis: ChatGPT plugin/app UI resource binding, resourceUri/outputTemplate compatibility and widget CSP/domain metadata

OPENAPI_3_1_2.basis: 3.1 patch compatibility and normative API description rules

POSTGRES_MCP_SECURITY.basis: open restricted-mode file-read security issue; typed technical failure policy

POSTGRES_MCP_SQLI.basis: open ExplainPlanTool SQL injection fix; no patched release verified

WEBRTC_STATS_W3C_2025.basis: WebRTC getStats identifiers and RTP/transport statistics used for bitrate, frames and resolution evidence

WEBRTC_W3C_2025.basis: WebRTC Recommendation defining RTCPeerConnection media transport APIs

WOO_HPOS.basis: HPOS compatibility and CRUD data-store access

WP_ABILITIES.basis: Abilities API REST exposure is opt-in; show_in_rest false by default

WP_SAFE_HTTP.basis: SSRF-safe HTTP for arbitrary URLs and redirect validation

WP_UPGRADER.basis: native upgrader, temporary backup/restore and core update semantics
